newsitem.title: USA: Synaptic in pact with Warner-Lambert.
newsitem.headline: Synaptic in pact with Warner-Lambert.

text.p: Synaptic Pharmaceutical Corp said Monday that it signed a collaborative research and licensing agreement with Warner-Lambert to identify and develop compounds that act upon receptors for the neurotransmitter galanin.

Synaptic said it could receive up to $34 million in milestone payments for the first two compounds identified as part of the collaboration, and additional milestone payments for other drugs identified through the collaboration.
Synaptic said it will also receive royalties on all product sales.

The agreement, which covers multiple therapeutic indications for such receptors, gives Warner-Lambert exclusive worldwide rights to develop, manufacture and market any compounds developed through the collaboration, Synaptic said.

Galanin receptors, which are widely distributed in the central nervous system and present in other organs, are believed to be useful drug targets for a variety of therapeutic indications, including Alzheimer's disease, depression, pain and endocrine disorders, Synaptic said.
